title: Quote
description: Large quotation with attribution (name + role + optional logo/photo), staggered reveal. Supports a dark default and an on-theme light variant.

text.description: The quotation text. Keep short (<= ~14 words) for on-screen readability.

role.description: Attribution role / source detail (e.g. 'Claude prompt-engineering docs').

photoSrc.description: Optional source logo / author photo (rendered as a 96px circle). Hidden if it fails to load.

variant.description: Color treatment. 'dark' (default) = accent-to-navy gradient with white text (backward compatible). 'light' = on-theme light card (surface/elevatedSurface background, theme text + muted text, accent rule) for light themes like the sky-blue Learning Friday series.

qtBgFrom.description: Override: gradient start color. Defaults from variant + theme.

qtBgTo.description: Override: gradient end color. Defaults from variant + theme.

qtAccent.description: Override: accent rule color. Defaults to theme accent.
